source.name: Destiny Data Compendium, Artifact Perks (Prismatic Transfer: "Doesn't stack with Radiant or other similar empowering buffs"); Court Stacking Guide
Court Stacking Guide (Global Debuffs)
source.note: Some debuffs override others regardless of value, e.g. Divinity over Particle Reconstruction. See docs/mechanics/damage-stacking.md.

source.name: Court Stacking Guide (Weapon Surges: "the highest same-Element Surge always takes priority")
source.note: Model each surge level (2x, 3x, 4x) as its own effect.

source.name: Court Stacking Guide (Amplification Modifiers: stackable with empowering buffs, debuffs and surges)
source.note: Stacking with other amplification effects is open; multiplicative is an assumption.

source.name: Court Stacking Guide (Weapon Perks)
source.note: Stacking of several perks on one weapon is open.
